business.title: Open a job position
business.goal: Publish a new job position with its hiring manager and headcount so candidates can apply.

steps.title: Open job position
steps.description: The recruiter enters title, department, description, headcount and the hiring manager of the position, and opens it.

steps.title: Review opened position
steps.description: The recruiter checks the position details and confirms it is open with zero hires.

outcome.statement: A job position is open and ready to receive applications.
evidence: The position appears in the open positions list with its title, department and headcount
The position shows its hiring manager

business.title: Register a candidate
business.goal: Record a candidate with name, email, resume link and source.

steps.title: Search existing candidates
steps.description: The recruiter searches by name or email to avoid registering the same person twice.

steps.title: Register candidate
steps.description: The recruiter enters the candidate's name, email, resume link and source and saves the record.

outcome.statement: The candidate is registered and available to apply to positions.
evidence: The candidate appears in the candidate list with email, resume link and source

business.title: Record an application
business.goal: Register that a candidate applies to an open position, starting in screening.

steps.title: Find the candidate
steps.description: The recruiter opens the candidate in hand or searches for them.

steps.title: Choose open position
steps.description: The recruiter selects the open job position the candidate applies to.

steps.title: Create application
steps.description: The recruiter records the application, which starts in the screening stage.

outcome.statement: The candidate has an application in screening for the chosen position.
evidence: The application appears in the position's pipeline under screening
The candidate's record lists the application

business.title: Move an application to interview
business.goal: Advance a screened application to the interview stage and pass it to the hiring manager when ready.

steps.title: Find screening applications
steps.description: The recruiter lists applications in screening for a position.

steps.title: Review application
steps.description: The recruiter reviews the candidate's resume link, source and application history.

steps.title: Move to interview
steps.description: The recruiter moves the application from screening to interview.

steps.title: Notify hiring manager
steps.description: The application in interview is passed to the position's hiring manager to decide on an offer.

outcome.statement: The application is in the interview stage and the hiring manager can decide on an offer.
evidence: The application appears in the hiring manager's pipeline

business.title: Reject an application
business.goal: Close an application that will not move forward, recording the reason.

steps.title: Find the application
steps.description: The recruiter opens the application in hand or searches it in the position's pipeline.

steps.title: Review application
steps.description: The recruiter checks the current stage and history before rejecting.

steps.title: Reject with reason
steps.description: The recruiter enters the rejection reason and moves the application to rejected.

outcome.statement: The application is rejected with a recorded reason.
evidence: The rejection reason is visible on the application

business.title: Decide on an offer
business.goal: Decide whether an interviewed candidate receives an offer for my position.

steps.title: Open interviewed application
steps.description: The hiring manager opens the application from the notification or from the interview list of their positions.

steps.title: Review candidate
steps.description: The hiring manager reviews the candidate, resume link and application history.

steps.title: Offer or send back
steps.description: The hiring manager chooses to extend an offer or to return the application to the recruiter for rejection.

steps.title: Move to offer
steps.description: When the choice is to offer, the hiring manager moves the application from interview to offer.

steps.title: Return to recruiter
steps.description: When the choice is not to offer, the application goes back to the recruiter to reject it with a reason.

outcome.statement: The interviewed application either moves to offer or returns to the recruiter for rejection.
evidence: The application shows stage offer, or
The recruiter sees the application flagged for rejection

business.title: Confirm a hire
business.goal: Mark an accepted offer as hired, filling the position's headcount.

steps.title: Find offer applications
steps.description: The hiring manager lists applications in offer for their positions.

steps.title: Review offer
steps.description: The hiring manager checks the candidate and the position's remaining headcount.

steps.title: Mark as hired
steps.description: The hiring manager moves the application to hired; when the hires reach the headcount the position closes automatically.

outcome.statement: The candidate is hired and the position's filled count is updated, closing the position when headcount is reached.
evidence: The position shows the updated hires count
A position with headcount filled shows status closed

business.title: Review my positions' pipeline
business.goal: See the applications of the positions I manage by stage.

steps.title: List my positions
steps.description: The hiring manager lists the job positions where they are the hiring manager.

steps.title: View position pipeline
steps.description: The hiring manager sees headcount, hires so far and applications grouped by stage.

outcome.statement: The hiring manager knows where each application of their positions stands.
evidence: Applications are shown per stage for each managed position
Headcount and hires count are visible per position
